{{Top|leg}}
The '''Officers' Candidacy Training''' was the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] training program. A recruit was required to have been enlisted for at least five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and have the necessary leadership qualities to participate in the program. This program offered the opportunity of rapid advancement. After the training, the officers could easily command a strategic military outpost, such as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] or even a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
